market_outlook.long_term: Higher-for-longer rate regime (3.75-4%+) pressures growth valuations. AI consolidation favors infrastructure over application layer. Energy transition accelerates with data center demand. Geopolitical oil risk structural. EM divergence widens. Gold/silver structural uptrend intact. Consumer resilience supported by record incomes but food inflation is a wildcard.
